articles.headline: Champions League talking points: Was this a good result for Man United?
articles.description: Gab Marcotti, Mark Ogden, Sam Tighe and Alex Kirkland run the rule over Man United's draw with Sporting, plus all the other moments that mattered from Matchday 5.

images.name: Moreno: Disallowing Sporting's equaliser would have 'bailed out' Lammens
images.caption: Ale Moreno criticises Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens for not 'catching the ball' in the build-up to Sporting CP's equaliser in their 2-2 Champions League draw.

articles.headline: Luis Enrique praises Roma after draw halts PSG's winning streak
articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain coach Luis Enrique said Roma was his team's "toughest match of this season" after a hard-fought 2-2 Champions League draw on Wednesday.

images.name: Luis Enrique - Gasperini [1296x729]
images.caption: Coach Luis Enrique's PSG had won 12 straight games before meeting Roma's Gian Piero Gasperini on Wednesday.
images.credit: Photo by Mustafa Yalcin/Anadolu via Getty Images
